score_rationale: The candidate demonstrates strong Python and mentoring skills but lacks essential IT support experience (Intune, Active Directory, first-line hardware/AV support) and any background working with children or in an educational setting, which are core to the role.
key_strengths: Expert-level Python proficiency, proven mentorship and leadership abilities, strong technical background in software engineering and systems design.
